note: Read/write mix axis intentionally dropped. WR-Raft affects the commit path only - reads are served from local applied state without quorum involvement, so read mix is not a meaningful axis for this evaluation. Grid is 3 heterogeneity profiles x 2 modes (vanilla/weighted), writes-only. Uniform profile expects uniform weights under BOTH modes since there is no real heterogeneity for the EWA to react to. A light background write load (20 ops/sec) runs during warmup and weight-convergence polling so the EWA has real AppendEntries latency to react to before the measured run begins.
